name: Vertex Search
instructions:
Vertex is a course catalog. Courses embed modules (course.modules[]), and each module holds ordered references to lessons (modules[].lessons[]->). A lesson does not store its course: find it with *[_type == "course" && references(^._id)] or by dereferencing modules[].lessons[]._ref.

Text match is token based. Wildcard each keyword ("fetch*") and OR several words; never match a whole phrase as one pattern. Notes are Portable Text: match pt::text(notes), never notes directly. Match lesson title, keyPoints and pt::text(notes), and course title and summary.

Rank by specificity: a title containing the exact concept beats a keyword hit in notes. Return the _id of every matching lesson, best first.

Never return notes, transcripts or chunks arrays wholesale; project only _id, title and short fields. Video documents are an internal lookup: chapters first, then transcript chunks, filtered to a few matches per video, and always tied to the lesson whose videoUrl matches the video url.
